This '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|offshoot]]''' lived at some point between the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. He was a medical student and became involved as a researcher in the project of [[Demagol|Antos Wyrick]], a [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], who sought to create [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children at his [[New Generation Academy|school]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Osadia]]. Using genetic material of the Arkanian [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]], the researchers attempted to modify children in vitro to enhance them with Force-sensitivity. The man and [[Edessa's mother|his wife]], another researcher, became the parents of the first child, a daughter named [[Jarael|Edessa]], which meant "triumph" in [[Arkanian (language)/Legends|Arkanian]]. However, several years later the school was attacked by [[Skyreaper drone]]s of a slaver organization known as [[the Crucible]], and all children there, including young Edessa, were taken captive.
